mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guilds ( name, description, invite_code, owner_user_id, max_members, guild_point, visibility, status ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{description}, #{inviteCode}, #{ownerUserId}, #{maxMembers}, COALESCE(#{guildPoint}, 0), COALESCE(#{visibility}, 'PRIVATE'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE') )
mapper.select: SELECT guild_id, name, description, invite_code, owner_user_id, max_members, guild_point, visibility, status, created_at, updated_at FROM guilds WHERE guild_id = #{guildId}

SELECT guild_id, name, description, invite_code, owner_user_id, max_members, guild_point, visibility, status, created_at, updated_at FROM guilds WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT g.guild_id, g.name, g.description, g.invite_code, COUNT(DISTINCT gm.guild_member_id) AS member_count, g.max_members, g.guild_point, owner.nickname AS owner_nickname, my_member.guild_id AS joined_guild_id, pending.request_id AS pending_request_id FROM guilds g JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = g.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN guild_members gm ON gm.guild_id = g.guild_id AND gm.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN guild_members my_member ON my_member.guild_id = g.guild_id AND my_member.user_id = #{userId} AND my_member.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN guild_join_requests pending ON pending.guild_id = g.guild_id AND pending.user_id = #{userId} AND pending.status = 'PENDING' WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY g.guild_id, g.name, g.description, g.invite_code, g.max_members, g.guild_point, owner.nickname, my_member.guild_id, pending.request_id, g.created_at
ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, g.guild_id DESC
ORDER BY g.guild_point DESC, g.created_at DESC, g.guild_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT g.guild_id, g.name, g.description, g.invite_code, COUNT(active_members.guild_member_id) AS member_count, g.max_members, g.guild_point, my_member.role AS my_role, my_member.joined_at FROM guild_members my_member JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = my_member.guild_id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN guild_members active_members ON active_members.guild_id = g.guild_id AND active_members.left_at IS NULL WHERE my_member.user_id = #{userId} AND my_member.left_at IS NULL GROUP BY g.guild_id, g.name, g.description, g.invite_code, g.max_members, g.guild_point, my_member.role, my_member.joined_at ORDER BY my_member.joined_at DESC

SELECT g.guild_id, g.name, g.invite_code, gm.role FROM guild_members gm JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = gm.guild_id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY gm.joined_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT g.guild_id, g.name, g.invite_code, gjr.request_id, gjr.status AS request_status, gjr.created_at AS request_created_at FROM guild_join_requests gjr JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = gjr.guild_id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE gjr.user_id = #{userId} AND gjr.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY gjr.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT g.guild_id, g.name, g.description, g.invite_code, g.owner_user_id, owner.nickname AS owner_nickname, COUNT(active_members.guild_member_id) AS member_count, g.max_members, g.guild_point, g.visibility, g.status, my_member.role AS my_role, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM guilds g JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = g.owner_user_id LEFT JOIN guild_members active_members ON active_members.guild_id = g.guild_id AND active_members.left_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN guild_members my_member ON my_member.guild_id = g.guild_id AND my_member.user_id = #{userId} AND my_member.left_at IS NULL WHERE g.guild_id = #{guildId} GROUP BY g.guild_id, g.name, g.description, g.invite_code, g.owner_user_id, owner.nickname, g.max_members, g.guild_point, g.visibility, g.status, my_member.role, g.created_at, g.updated_at

SELECT gm.guild_member_id AS member_id, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level, c.stage AS character_stage, c.mood AS character_mood, c.appearance_type AS character_appearance_type, c.streak_days, gm.role, gm.joined_at, gm.left_at FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN gm.role = 'OWNER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, gm.joined_at ASC, gm.guild_member_id ASC
SELECT gm.guild_member_id AS member_id, gm.user_id, gm.role, gm.joined_at, gm.left_at FROM guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.user_id = #{userId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT gm.guild_member_id AS member_id, gm.user_id, gm.role, gm.joined_at, gm.left_at FROM guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE guild_members SET role = 'MEMBER', joined_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, left_at = NULL WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT gm.guild_member_id AS member_id, gm.user_id, gm.role, gm.joined_at, gm.left_at FROM guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.guild_member_id = #{memberId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT gm.guild_member_id AS member_id, gm.user_id, gm.role, gm.joined_at, gm.left_at FROM guild_members gm WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.guild_member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1

SELECT gm.guild_member_id AS member_id, u.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level, c.stage AS character_stage, c.mood AS character_mood, c.appearance_type AS character_appearance_type, c.streak_days, gm.role, gm.joined_at, gm.left_at FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.guild_member_id = #{memberId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM guild_members gm JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = gm.guild_id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM guild_join_requests gjr JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = gjr.guild_id AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE gjr.user_id = #{userId} AND gjr.status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND left_at IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT gn.notice_id, gn.guild_id, gn.writer_user_id, writer.nickname AS writer_nickname, gn.title, gn.content, gn.created_at, gn.updated_at FROM guild_notices gn JOIN users writer ON writer.user_id = gn.writer_user_id WHERE gn.guild_id = #{guildId} ORDER BY gn.created_at DESC, gn.notice_id DESC

SELECT gn.notice_id, gn.guild_id, gn.writer_user_id, writer.nickname AS writer_nickname, gn.title, gn.content, gn.created_at, gn.updated_at FROM guild_notices gn JOIN users writer ON writer.user_id = gn.writer_user_id WHERE gn.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gn.notice_id = #{noticeId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guild_notices ( guild_id, writer_user_id, title, content ) VALUES ( #{guildId}, #{writerUserId}, #{title}, #{content} )
mapper.update: UPDATE guild_notices SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guild_join_requests ( guild_id, user_id, status ) VALUES ( #{guildId}, #{userId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'PENDING') )
mapper.select: SELECT gjr.request_id, gjr.guild_id, g.name AS guild_name, g.invite_code, g.description AS guild_description, gjr.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level, gjr.status, gjr.handled_by, handler.nickname AS handled_by_nickname, gjr.created_at, gjr.handled_at FROM guild_join_requests gjr JOIN guilds g ON g.guild_id = gjr.guild_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gjr.user_id LEFT JOIN users handler ON handler.user_id = gjr.handled_by LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gjr.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gjr.request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE guild_join_requests SET status = 'APPROVED', handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE guild_join_requests SET status = 'REJECTED', handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE guild_join_requests SET status = 'CANCELED', handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE guild_id = #{guildId} AND request_id = #{requestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE guild_join_requests SET status = 'CANCELED', handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_id != #{excludeRequestId} AND status = 'PENDING'
